item.title: Why Canada's reaction to Israel's invasion of Lebanon is so different this time
item.summary: Canada's response to Israel's 2026 invasion of Lebanon has been unequivocal condemnation of what Prime Minister Mark Carney called "an illegal invasion." That's a marked contrast to Stephen Harper's defence of Israel's 2006 invasion.

item.title: Gunman near Israeli Consulate in Istanbul killed, Turkish governor says
item.summary: Three assailants opened fire at police outside a building housing the Israeli Consulate in Istanbul on Tuesday, sparking a gunfight that left one attacker dead, Turkish officials said. The two other assailants were captured with injuries.

item.title: Trump agrees to 2-week ceasefire as Iran says it will allow passage through Strait of Hormuz
item.summary: U.S. ‌President ​Donald Trump said ​early Tuesday evening that he ​has ⁠agreed "to ⁠suspend ‌the bombing ⁠and attack on ‌Iran for a ​period ⁠of ⁠two ⁠weeks" subject to Iran reopening the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Decorated Australian soldier Ben Roberts-Smith charged with killing 5 unarmed Afghans during war
item.summary: Australia's most decorated living veteran, Ben Roberts-Smith, faces war crime charges on allegations he killed five unarmed Afghans while serving in Afghanistan from 2009 and 2012, police and media reported on Tuesday.

item.title: Woman, toddler daughter among 3 killed in Russia drone attack in Ukraine's Odesa
item.summary: Russia launched a drone attack on Ukraine's Black Sea port of Odesa overnight Monday, killing a 30-year-old woman, her two-year-old daughter and another woman, while damaging residential buildings and energy infrastructure, the regional governor said.

item.title: Amid political tensions, King Charles will be in a 'delicate diplomatic situation' during U.S. state visit
item.summary: The timing of King Charles's upcoming state visit to the United States has sparked controversy and questions — particularly given the ongoing U.S.-Israel war against Iran, the geopolitical turmoil it has caused and the current strain in the relationship between the United King...

item.title: Israeli airstrike kills 4 Palestinians in Gaza, medics say
item.summary: An Israeli airstrike killed four Palestinians in the northern Gaza Strip on Sunday, local health authorities said, in the latest violence to overshadow ‌a fragile ceasefire amid a new push by mediators to bolster the agreement.

item.title: How the war in the Middle East is already impacting mortgage rates in Canada
item.summary: The ongoing war in Iran and the closure of the Strait of Hormuz are impacting Canadian pocketbooks in ways we might not expect. Experts warn Canadian homeowners facing mortgage renewals that rates are going up, despite the Bank of Canada holding its key interest rate for months.
